definition: Mark Chen is chief Research Officer at OpenAI.
details: Created Image GPT, co-created Codex, led multimodal GPT-4o development, and oversees OpenAI's frontier research organization. Chen Tan-sun (Chinese: 陳唐山; pinyin: Chén Tángshān; Pe̍h-ōe-jī: Tân Tông-san; born 16 September 1935), also known by his English name Mark Chen, is a Taiwanese politician and atmospheric scientist who served as Secretary-General of the Office of the President of Taiwan under former President Chen Shui-bian. He was also previously Foreign Minister of the ROC from 2004 to 2006 (the first Democratic Progressive Party member to occupy the position).
